name: 10DLC SMS Compliance
statute: FCC 10DLC / TCPA — SMS Marketing Registration (47 CFR 64.1200)
target_buyer: E-commerce brands, SaaS companies, marketing agencies using SMS

icp.company_size: Any size — all businesses sending SMS marketing
icp.trigger: Uses Klaviyo, Attentive, Yext, or any SMS API to send marketing texts

detection_signals: Campaign registered with The Campaign Registry (TCR)?
Carrier-approved use case matches actual campaign content
TCPA one-to-one consent language on opt-in page
Registered phone number matches sending number
enforcement_cases: FCC enforcement: $10,000/day for unregistered SMS campaigns (2024)
TCPA class actions: $1,000-$2,000 per text message
